cases.name: Crystal "Chrissy" Lynn Donavant Averett
cases.about: Her friend Lisa Bowser said, “She was a good-hearted person,” she said, adding, however, that she could have “her bad days.” “She played the cards that life dealt her,” Bowser said. Averett lost a son early on after her marriage, she said. But she persevered. “She still lived life, she still had fun,” Bowser said, adding that she had endured an abusive marriage. “She still maintained. She did what she needed to do.”
